pages.title: Crunchy Bumpkin
pages.text: Race 6: Los Angeles, 4.8 miles. Password: STARS. One of three songs with an FM lead on top of the band; the others are Loser and the Title Screen. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: The craze
pages.text: Inline skates were the craze of the day: US sales grew from $22 million in 1989 to over $70 million in 1990. Emergency rooms saw 37,000 skaters in 1993 and expected 83,000 in 1994.

pages.title: What's the worst?
pages.text: Programmer Brian Plank, in this game's credits too, is why FIFA Soccer sounds techno: the producer wanted TV-sports horns, Brian told Jeff to do what he felt was right.
